# 1894. Find the Student that Will Replace the Chalk

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def chalkReplacer(self, chalk, k):
        """
        :type chalk: List[int]
        :type k: int
        :rtype: int
        """
        total_chalk = sum(chalk)
        k %= total_chalk
        ans = -1
        for i, num in enumerate(chalk):
            if num > k:
                ans = i
                break
            k -= num
        return ans
```
